gloss: adding water; water added while cooking

definitions.gloss: adding water; water added while cooking
definitions.explanation: The act of adding cold water to a pot during cooking, especially when boiling noodles or beans, to prevent them from boiling over or to control the cooking process.

examples.japanese: {麺|めん}を{茹|ゆ}でるとき、{差|さ}し{水|みず}をした。
examples.english: I added cold water when boiling the noodles.

examples.japanese: {鍋|なべ}が{吹|ふ}きこぼれそうになったら{差|さ}し{水|みず}をしてください。
examples.english: If the pot is about to boil over, please add some cold water.

notes: Also called {呼|よ}び{水|みず} in some regions. A traditional Japanese cooking technique, especially used when boiling {蕎麦|そば} or {饂飩|うどん}. The cold water temporarily stops the boiling, which helps cook the noodles more evenly. Also written as {差|さ}し{水|みず}. Can also be used figuratively to mean pouring cold water on a heated discussion. Collocations: {差|さ}し{水|みず}をする (to add water to a pot).
